# PDF editing test font

`test-cjk.ttf` is an original Apache-2.0 fixture with distinct simple glyph contours for
中文修改 and a space. It tests Unicode CID font replacement and PDF text extraction;
it is not a UI font or a visual reference for Chinese typography.

Only test builds resolve the `simhei` choice to this fixture. Production builds keep
loading SimHei from the Windows Fonts directory. CI does not need optional language fonts.

Regenerate with `generate-font.py` using Python and fonttools. The fixed timestamp makes
the generated bytes reproducible. The repository [license](../../../../../LICENSE) applies.
